geometryEvidence.summary: Brochure sample body diameter and height, with reconstructed exterior.
geometryEvidence.limitations: Only nominal body Ø11 mm and total height 7.9 mm anchor this reconstruction. Ears, slots, wall thickness and key details are approximate; shorting clip omitted. The brochure lists A/B/C product codes but does not dimension their different key shapes, so those codes are not assigned to invented variants. AK-1 family corresponds to the stated CA281A/CA282B interface, not verified model-to-model mating. Not AK-2 and not a complete pocket or holder.
